managedExtensions.sampling: Fractional ratios use rational geometry and area-weighted averaging. Three-row integer kernels include all three rows, unlike the pinned upstream selector.
managedExtensions.execution: Portable managed SIMD and opt-in MCU-row parallel processing preserve serial arithmetic and JPEG bytes. Caches have independent bounded budgets with rolling or streaming fallbacks.
managedExtensions.colorManagement: SourceIccProfile adds managed ICC v2/v4 RGB/grayscale matrix/TRC and LUT conversion through D50 XYZ before sampling and quantization.
managedExtensions.metadata: Structured Exif, XMP and IPTC editing and explicit reconciliation supplement opaque marker embedding.
managedExtensions.validation: Out-of-range floats require finite computations and eight-bit coefficient preflight; unsupported ICC models and offset-sensitive Exif structures fail explicitly.

qualityCompressionParityEvidence.scope: All 24 Kodak RGB8 photographs plus 8 controls; YCbCr 4:4:4 and 4:2:0, baseline 0 and progressive 2, AQ and optimized Huffman, force_baseline, direct distances 0.25..8, no smoothing, restarts or ICC. Fixed size, PSNR and local-luma-SSIM noninferiority bounds.

performanceValidation.scope: The complete 256-case RGB8 YCbCr comparison at be14f89 has valid timing evidence. All four Kodak photograph groups pass both the 1.05 group-mean and 1.10 individual bounds; all four control groups pass the 1.05 group bound while 15 individual control cases exceed 1.10.
